name: @crombolo/cli
description: The crombolo command line: scaffolding a site, schema, views, domains, content transfer and upgrades.
author: Crombolo

api-client.description: the API client a site seeds from its environment

agents.description: AGENTS.md, the guide for coding agents working on this site

assets.description: the stylesheets and scripts beside the components

audit.description: who did what, and when: the audit log, to read or to ship elsewhere

bundle.description: the bundle format: sign, verify and digest a bundle

cache.description: the published cache on every node

components.description: the components in components/: check, list, new

content.description: pages and Library elements: make them, change their values and blocks, move and publish them

content:blueprint.description: blueprints: a page's values saved as a starting point for new pages of its type

content:block.description: a page's blocks: add, change, move and remove them

content:menu.description: a menu's items, by its alias: show, add, move and remove them

domains.description: the hostnames this site answers on (domains.toml)

events.description: what is waiting to go out to webhooks and e-mail, and sending failures again

extension.description: extensions: install, grant, configure and check them, see what they did, and purge their tables

forms.description: the site's forms: make, list, show, change and remove them

forms:field.description: a form's fields: add, change, move and remove them

forms:group.description: the fieldsets on a form's pages: add, change, move and remove them

forms:page.description: a form's pages: add, change, move and remove them

forms:workflow.description: what happens to a form's entries: add, change and remove its workflows

import.description: replace this site with a whole-site file; import an Umbraco backup

index.description: the search indexes: what they hold, and rebuilding them

jobs.description: the site's and its bundles' background jobs: list them, see one, run a failed one again

keys.description: keys that sign site bundles: your own, and the ones this site trusts

languages.description: the languages a site is written in (languages.toml)

maintenance.description: pause and resume editors' saves, cluster-wide

media.description: the media library: list, find, show and change items, import and export folders; a pulled site's files

media:access.description: who can see and change a media folder or item: show it, set it

media:folder.description: media folders: make one, and those above it

profile.description: the sites commands reach by name with --profile, kept in ~/.crombolo/profiles

recycle-bin.description: what has been deleted, before it is gone for good

remote.description: a hosted site's trusted CI jobs, and its pull and push jobs

remote:trust.description: the CI jobs a hosted site trusts: add, list, disable, enable and remove them

seed.description: a site's starting content, written as files and applied

seo.description: search and sharing: what every page falls back to, the robots file and the not-found page

site.description: the site as a whole: what it is, and how page addresses are built

tokens.description: command-line tokens, for a script or a CI job to run commands as you

types.description: schema-as-code: the content types, data types and languages in schema/

types:property.description: a type's properties: add, change, move and remove them

types:tab.description: a type's tabs: add, rename, move and remove them

upgrade.description: framework migrations: check, plan, apply, ledger

users.description: the back-office users: unlock, enable, reset a password or a second factor, invite

users:groups.description: user groups: the site's own and those made in the back office

webhooks.description: the webhooks kept with the site, in schema/webhooks

workflows:stage.description: an approval workflow's stages: add, change and remove them
